mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (indicating accommodative monetary policy) reduces the discount rate for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.0% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns do not occur when both series decline by more than 1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE declines by more than 0.2 percentage points in the prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (indicating labor market weakness) is associated with lower corporate earnings growth and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing output index (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a contraction in industrial production that reduces corporate profits and triggers equity sell-offs, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 105.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low housing market activity regimes (HOUST < 900.0), a decline in housing starts signals a weakening real estate sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 900.0 and HOUST declines by more than 1% in the prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) indicates a central bank's struggle to control inflation without stifling growth, causing equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns do not occur when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.
